statement: For a nontrivial primitive actual Juggler cycle with minimum m>1, period L and odd count o, write Lambda=o*log(3)-L*log(2) and b(m)=log(log(m^2+1)/(2*log(m))). Exact normalized logarithmic floor losses telescope to Lambda. The compulsory last-even loss and distinct integer targets give 0<b(m)<=Lambda<log(log(m+L)/log(m)). Consequently, IF L*Lambda<=C then L<=C/b(m)<C*(m^2+1)*log(m^2+1), without a cubic-height hypothesis. The two unconditional sides alone give only the vacuous lower bound L>sqrt(m^2+1)-m. AI-assisted written proof, not Lean or independently human reviewed. No uniform surplus estimate, unconditional period upper bound, or cycle exclusion is claimed.

There are infinitely many coprime pairs (L,o), with o=ceil(L*log(2)/log(3)), whose primitive rational mechanical words start OO, end EOE, have all noncontracting prefixes and the stronger even-endpoint prefix envelope, yet L*(o*log(3)-L*log(2))>=L*log(3)/4 tends to infinity. The construction uses adjacent upper/lower convergents p/q,r/s and k=ceil((alpha*s-r+1/4)/(p-alpha*q)), o=kp+r,L=kq+s. These are formal words only: no integer floor-cell realization or actual cycle is supplied, and they are not identified with the irrational greedy hug word.
